why: A Salesforce app that feeds the hub sits with the other sources of customer data below it
Salesforce apps that use the hub's data (engagement) sit above it
An ETL or integration tool loading the hub sits below it (Informatica in the Well-Architected examples)
Data flows left to right: sources on the left
Systems of record exchanging data both ways sit with the sources
Data lakes and warehouses feeding the hub sit on the left
Web and mobile apps sending events sit below the hub (ingestion)
